title: History of the Argentina national rugby union team

photo.caption: The first Argentina national team ever before playing the British Lions at Sociedad Sportiva Argentina, 12 June 1910
photo.description: Rugby team of Argentina that played v British Isles at Sociedad Sportiva. (standing); C. Mold, L. Gribbell, W. Stocks (referee), W. Hayman, A. Donnelly; (sitting): J. Saffery, F. Sawyer, F. de C. Heriot, H. Talbot, O. Saint Gebbie (captain), W. Watson, A. Bovet, A. Reid, C. McCarthy, F. Henrys. (Barry Heatlie is missing).

photo.caption: Rosario A.C. squad of 1884, the oldest photo of a rugby team in Argentina.
photo.description: The Rosario Athletic Club rugby team of 1884, considered the oldest photo of a rugby team in Argentina. Players were C.E. Baines, W. Graham, A. Musgrove, Williamson, A. Dickensen, R.C. Baines (cap), Bolland, Geary, Hall, Hanckell, Miles, Parry, Topping, Keenan, Jones.

photo.caption: The team that played the first test against the British Lions in 1927
photo.description: The Argentine national rugby team that played its first test (of four) v. the British Lions. Argentina lost 37-0.

photo.caption: Marcelo Pascual diving in the ingoal of Junior Springboks on June 19, 1965, during the tour of South Africa. That match is considered the beginning of a new era for the national rugby team.
photo.description: Marcelo Pascual diving in the ingoal of Junior Springboaks in 1965, Los Pumas' first great international victory.

photo.caption: The team that beat Australia in 1979 in Buenos Aires.
photo.description: The Argentina national rugby team before playing Australia at Ferro Carril Oeste, Buenos Aires.

photo.caption: Hugo Porta played 19 years for the Pumas, scoring 590 points.
photo.description: Argentine fly-half Hugo Porta raise his hands to salute fans after Argentina beat France in a rugby union test match played at Ferro C. Oeste stadium of Buenos Aires.

photo.caption: Los Pumas achieved a 21–21 tie v. the All Blacks on Nov 2, 1985.
photo.description: Los Pumas - All Blacks second test match played in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Tomás Petersen (left) carries the ball while Ernesto Ure (right) follows the action.

photo.caption: The Pumas during their November 2006 win over England at Twickenham.
